A Dakota arrived at the museum in 2017 and was reported by Dutch regional media and by DagjeWeg.NL; no serial published

The Dutch Wikipedia article records that the recovered remains of a British Lancaster which crashed at Glabbeek in Belgium are laid out in the museum park in the contours of the aircraft; the type is given as Lancaster in that source and as a four-engined RAF bomber elsewhere so the identification needs checking on the ground
